value.rationale: Geometric return-time sets are a specifically motivated nonsyndetic class. The theorem gives the sharp entropy cost of rare markers, distinguishes their iterated-log leading behavior from finite-gap systems, and identifies a bona fide nonconstant lattice term with all cluster values. This is a structural endpoint result for a canonical constrained dynamical invariant, rather than an arbitrary numeric slice or computational transcription.
